title: Amidakuji
tagline: The ghost-leg ladder of Japan: build it, trace it, draw lots.
description: Follow a line down and take every rung. Build ladders that bring every paper lantern home, trace a path against the clock, or draw lots with friends on one device. Hints that teach, a Daily Ladder and Watch and Learn. Portrait or landscape.
howToPlay: Each lantern slides down its line and crosses every rung it meets.
Tap between two lines to add a rung, tap your rung again to take it back.
Press Release: every lantern must land in the bowl with its own colour and number.
Tap the lamp for a hint: where to look, then why it works.
Try Follow the Line against the clock, or Draw Lots with friends.
